run.intent: Improve arithmetic mean accuracy with math.fsum while preserving zero for empty sequences and passing the existing and added accuracy tests.

findings.explanation: The changed implementation unconditionally divides by len(values), so average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError instead of preserving the documented and existing behavior of returning zero for an empty sequence.
findings.action: Handle empty input before dividing, while using fsum for non-empty sequences.
